title: NOAA puts three AI-based global models into operation
summary: AIGFS (retrained from GraphCast) uses up to 99.7% less computing than GFS (a 16-day forecast in about 40 minutes); AIGEFS has skill comparable to GEFS with 9% of the computing; and HGEFS (62 hybrid members) outperforms GEFS and AIGEFS on most metrics. Cyclone intensity worsened in AIGFS v1.0; the announcement gives no numerical scores.

evidence.tested: The release describes initial or early testing and claims skill comparable to GEFS and better ensemble performance, but gives no metrics, verification datasets or time periods.
evidence.unknown: The release states that AIGFS v1.0 degraded tropical cyclone intensity forecasts, that AIGEFS ensemble spread is still being improved, and that HGEFS hurricane intensity is being improved.
evidence.ai_role: AI global models: AIGFS forecasts with up to 99.7% less compute; AIGEFS is a 31-member AI ensemble with 9% of the GEFS computing; HGEFS combines 31 GEFS and 31 AIGEFS members.
